method.method_draft: Write one rate equation for each trial using rate = k[NO]^m[Br2]^n. Divide the Trial 2 equation by the Trial 1 equation to cancel k and the [NO]^m term: (1.04 × 10^-2)/(5.20 × 10^-3) = (0.20/0.10)^n, giving 2 = 2^n and n = 1. Divide the Trial 3 equation by the Trial 1 equation to cancel k and the [Br2]^n term: (2.08 × 10^-2)/(5.20 × 10^-3) = (0.40/0.20)^m, giving 4 = 2^m and m = 2. Therefore the rate law is rate = k[NO]^2[Br2].

推理：设速率方程为 rate = k[NO]^m[Br2]^n。比较 Trial 2 和 Trial 1：[NO] 相同，只有 [Br2] 从 0.10 M 增加到 0.20 M，即加倍；速率从 5.20 × 10^-3 增加到 1.04 × 10^-2，也加倍。因此 (1.04 × 10^-2)/(5.20 × 10^-3) = (0.20/0.10)^n，得到 2 = 2^n，所以 n = 1。比较 Trial 3 和 Trial 1：[Br2] 相同，只有 [NO] 从 0.20 M 增加到 0.40 M，即加倍；速率从 5.20 × 10^-3 增加到 2.08 × 10^-2，即变为 4 倍。因此 (2.08 × 10^-2)/(5.20 × 10^-3) = (0.40/0.20)^m，得到 4 = 2^m，所以 m = 2。因此速率方程为 rate = k[NO]^2[Br2]。
